title: 第101章：砖头自己长腿跑了？
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“张伯，安安不是普通孩子，她没问题的。”

众人面面相觑，不明白秦昭岚说的话是什么意思。

秦昭岚转头，跟苏安安使了一个眼色。

苏安安立刻会意，来到砖头堆前，将砖头收进储物空间。

堵住矿井的砖头，顿时减少了一小半。

苏安安在众人惊讶的目光下，哒哒哒地跑向远处，将砖头全部倒了出来。

她来回跑了四趟，才将堵住矿井的砖头搬完。

“这……砖头怎么自己长腿跑……跑了？”

“是啊，而且这些砖头似乎是跟着安安小姐的。安安小姐去哪儿，砖头就跟着去哪儿，这也太神奇了！”

“难道这就是秦夫人说的，安安小姐不是普通孩子？”

众人看向苏安安，眼眸里溢满了疑惑和探究。

苏安安不知道要怎么解释这件事情，扬起软白的小脸，看向秦昭岚求助。

秦昭岚将手轻轻地搭在她的肩膀上，“安安能将大量物品收起来，也能随时将收起来的物品拿出来。”

刘大勇一拍脑门，“我知道了，士兵手里的武器和衣裳，都是被安安小姐收走的。”

“不错！”秦昭岚点头。

众人闻言，看向苏安安的眼眸里，溢满了惊喜。

“真是没想到啊，安安小姐居然有这样的能力，真厉害！”

“难怪安安小姐有吃不完的食物。我们能遇见秦夫人和安安小姐，真是祖上积德啊！”

众人庆幸逃过一劫，秦昭岚却眉头紧皱。

这里离两国交界的界河很近，两国的人马都来过了。

这里有铁矿的事情，很能瞒多久？

一旦铁矿一事暴露，不是把铁矿交出去那么简单。

他们这些人，恐怕都会没命。

苏安安仰起小脑袋，发现秦昭岚的脸色不好看。

她抬起小手，轻轻地拉了拉她的衣角。

“娘亲，你怎么不高兴呀？”

“娘亲没有不高兴，娘只是担心，以后还会有人来这里，跟咱们抢铁矿。”

秦昭岚抿唇，低头看向苏安安。

她知道，这些事情不该告诉安安，让她徒增烦劳。

只是她想用铁矿打造兵器，这事儿需要跟安安商量。

想着，她在苏安安的面前蹲下。

Page (1/3)

"Uncle Zhang, An An is not an ordinary child, she will be fine."

Everyone looked at each other in confusion, not understanding what Qin Zhaolan meant.

Qin Zhaolan turned around and winked at Su Anan.

Su Anan understood immediately, came to the pile of bricks, and put the bricks into the storage space.

The number of bricks blocking the mine was suddenly reduced by less than half.

Under the surprised eyes of everyone, Su Anan ran away and poured out all the bricks.

It took her four trips to move the bricks blocking the mine.

"This...why did Brick run...away on his own?"

"Yes, and these bricks seem to follow Miss An An. Wherever Miss An An goes, the bricks follow. This is amazing!"

"Is this what Mrs. Qin said, that Miss An An is not an ordinary child?"

Everyone looked at Su Anan, their eyes filled with doubts and inquiries.

Su Anan didn't know how to explain this matter, so she raised her soft white face and looked to Qin Zhaolan for help.

Qin Zhaolan put his hand gently on her shoulder, "An'an can put away a large number of items and can also take out the put away items at any time."

Liu Dayong slapped his forehead and said, "I understand. The weapons and clothes in the hands of the soldiers were all taken away by Miss An An."

"Not bad!" Qin Zhaolan nodded.

Hearing this, everyone looked at Su Anan with eyes full of surprise.

"I really didn't expect that Miss An An actually has such an ability. It's so amazing!"

"No wonder Miss An An has endless food. We can meet Mrs. Qin and Miss An An, it's really a blessing from our ancestors!"

Everyone was happy to have escaped, but Qin Zhaolan frowned.

It is very close to the boundary river between the two countries, and people from both countries have been here.

There is an iron ore here. How long can we hide it?

Once the iron ore matter is exposed, it is not as simple as handing over the iron ore.

All of them will probably die.

Su Anan raised her little head and found that Qin Zhaolan's face looked ugly.

She raised her little hand and gently pulled the corner of her clothes.

"Mother, why are you unhappy?"

"Mom is not unhappy, she is just worried that someone will come here in the future to rob us of iron ore."

Qin Zhaolan pursed her lips and looked down at Su Anan.

She knew that she shouldn't tell An An these things, which would cause her trouble in vain.

It's just that she wants to use iron ore to make weapons, and she needs to discuss this with An An.

Thinking about it, she squatted down in front of Su An'an.
